name: North America and havens
notes: USA, Canada, Puerto Rico and the dollar havens (Bermuda, Bahamas, Caymans, BVI); the reference zone; havens follow North America (A)

name: Caribbean
notes: The Caribbean islands outside Cuba and the dollar havens; tourism lags the US (A)

name: Cuba
notes: Cuba alone: isolated by the embargo, low intensity and its own shocks (A)

name: North Korea
notes: North Korea alone: sealed economy, low intensity and its own shocks (A)

name: European Union
notes: The 27 EU members plus Norway, Iceland, the Balkans, Ukraine, Moldova, the microstates, the Faroes, Greenland and Saint Pierre and Miquelon; the euro crisis makes it swing harder (A)

name: United Kingdom
notes: UK with Gibraltar, the Isle of Man, Jersey and Guernsey (A)

name: China
notes: China, its debt vassals (Pakistan, Sri Lanka, Djibouti, Zambia) and close clients (Laos, Cambodia, Mongolia); state-steered credit damps the cycle (A)

name: South Korea
notes: South Korea alone since batch 154 (Logan), when Japan got its own zone 25 (A)

name: Hong Kong
notes: Hong Kong alone since batch 154 (Logan), when Taiwan went with Japan to zone 25 (A)

name: Australia
notes: Australia, New Zealand and the Pacific islands (A)

name: Macau
notes: Macau alone: its own country row MAC since batch 153 (Logan), while China stays in zone 7; casino money swings hard (A)

name: Singapore
notes: Singapore and Southeast Asia: Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, Vietnam, the Philippines, Brunei, Myanmar and Timor-Leste (A)

name: India
notes: India, Bangladesh and the Maldives; Pakistan and Sri Lanka are Chinese debt vassals and sit in zone 7 (A)

name: Southern Africa
notes: South Africa, DR Congo, Angola and the SADC south and Indian Ocean (A)

name: West Africa
notes: West and Central Africa from Cabo Verde to the Congo Republic and Chad, including Mali, a US debt vassal (A)

name: East Africa
notes: Kenya, Ethiopia, the Great Lakes, the Horn outside Djibouti, Sudan, South Sudan, Seychelles and Comoros (A)

name: North and Northwest Africa
notes: Morocco, Algeria, Tunisia, Libya and Mauritania (A)

name: Switzerland
notes: Switzerland and Liechtenstein; the safe haven swings least (A)

name: Middle East
notes: The Gulf, the Levant, Iraq, Iran, Turkey, Egypt and Yemen (A)

name: Upper Asia (Himalayas)
notes: Central Asia, the Caucasus, Afghanistan, Nepal and Bhutan; Russia has its own zone 26 since batch 154 (Logan) (A)

name: Mexico
notes: Mexico and Central America from Guatemala and Belize to Costa Rica (A)

name: Brazil
notes: Brazil, Paraguay, Bolivia, Guyana and Suriname (A)

name: Argentina
notes: Argentina, Chile, Uruguay and Papa's Port (the Falklands); Argentina's debt crises make it swing hardest (A)

name: Colombia
notes: Colombia, Venezuela, Ecuador, Peru and Panama (A)

name: Japan
notes: Japan and Taiwan (Logan, batch 154); ESE, until then the HRX Tokyo board, is the zone exchange; a mature, low-growth economy swings less (T)

name: Russia
notes: Russia and Belarus, its close client (Logan, batch 154; Belarus A); commodity swings would give about 1.4, but sanctions since 2005 partly isolate it: intensity 1.1, contagion 0.2 and a small own shock (T)
